sara_cs: Hi ops/net 10: Proxima Capital trial hit staging limits during their QA run. Renewal in 2 weeks; demo next Wed. Need short APAC allowlist + header bypass + QPS bump to 100 for 90 minutes to cover demo window.
sara_cs: Env=staging, customer=proxima-cap, reason=partner-demo, renewal_risk=medium-high
hamid_ops: Please post CIDRs and exact local time window. Also clarify whether this is for peered egress or proxy-only.
sara_cs: CIDRs: 203.0.113.128/28 and 198.51.100.80/29. Window: 2026-05-12 10:00 - 11:30 SGT. Prefer peered IP allowlist + X-Org header fallback (value: Proxima-Demo).
rina_net: I can provision the peering rules. Will create NET ticket and schedule pre-warm. Recommend pre-warm KV cache 20m before start and increase conn pool by 2x for window.
rina_net: Proposed fragment:
```
allowlist:
  - "203.0.113.128/28"
  - "198.51.100.80/29"
header_bypass:
  X-Org: "Proxima-Demo"
qps_tmp: 100
pool_multiplier: 2.0
prewarm_at: "2026-05-12T01:40:00Z"
window_utc: "2026-05-12T02:00:00Z/2026-05-12T03:30:00Z"
```
theo_se: Note: they use streaming and long prompts. Set max_tokens_per_request=600 and prefix_cache_ttl=1200s. Also enable model-fallback policy to bert-small if p99 > 600ms.
hamid_ops: Creating tickets now. Need CS-lead approval since QPS bump > self-serve. Who signs?
sara_cs: CS lead @diane_cs verbally greenlit for demos. I'll add Diane to the ticket for audit trail.
infra-bot: Queued changes: NET-9781, OPS-7012. Prewarm job scheduled at 2026-05-12T01:40:00Z.
rina_net: NET-9781 created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/NET-9781. OPS-7012: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/OPS-7012. Labels: apac-demo, temp-qps, customer-onboard.
infra-bot: Allowlist applied to staging at 2026-05-12T01:41:05Z. KV pre-warm run started.
theo_se: Monitoring: p95 ~ 110ms, p99 ~ 420ms during prewarm spikes but stable. If p99 > 650ms after switch, we'll auto-roll to fallback model.
hamid_ops: Final switch executed at 2026-05-12T02:00:10Z. QPS uplift active. Observability link: https://observ.redwood.internal/d/proxima/demo-window
infra-bot: QPS uplift active for staging 2026-05-12T02:00:10Z -> scheduled rollback at 2026-05-12T03:30:00Z.
sara_cs: Demo completed. Customer reported no throttles; they liked latency. I'll file follow-up to capture feedback and update renewal tracker.
theo_se: Action item: capture sample prompts for eval and check for any quality regressions due to caching.
hamid_ops: Postmortem note: no errors, short p99 spikes during first 2 mins only. Rolling labels to customer record.
sara_cs: Thanks all 389 I'll update customer and renewal score after review.
